name: Jake Burns
source:
"Raise the flag you guys! There's a mountain of treasure in front of us!"

The captain of a crew of pirates.
An overbearing guy who is quite confident but he's actually quite kind and treasures his comrades above all else, especially his right hand man [url=/c42785]Crave[/url] who he's know since he was a kid.
Even though he's a pirate he only targets corrupt merchants and other pirates who do bad deeds, he leaves good merchants and normal ships alone.
